submission.natural_language_explanation: The positive pole fires on the sub-word fragments of an unfamiliar, non-lexical letter string - an unseen acronym or ticker, a mixed letter-digit identifier, an e-mail local part, handle, hash or citation key - that the model cannot resolve to a dictionary word: activation is spread over the whole string ('RR' 0.7 then 'V' 2.5 inside 'RRV', 0.5-2.4 across 'X','K','Z') with the peak on one of its fragments, while the same letters inside ordinary words, familiar single-token acronyms (IBM, NASA, LLC, ABC), misspellings and non-English text leave it near zero. It is strongest when the unknown string is introduced as the label of a named entity ('The company Rentz (RRV)...' 3.8 vs 'Rentz (RRV)...' 1.7), so it is a retrospective detector of label/identifier strings being read out character by character rather than a next-token predictor.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The company Rentz (RRV) is a small manufacturer of recreational vehicles based in Ohio. Its shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker IBM.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same 'Label (TICKER)' frame and 'Rentz' subject as top example 3, but the parenthetical is a familiar acronym the hypothesis says leaves the pole near zero.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The patient was homozygous for the V158 variant, and the same substitution was confirmed by Sanger sequencing in three independent samples from the family. Anti-TNF therapy was started the following week.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Alphanumeric genotype written out in words ('V158', no '@lab') with a prose continuation, which the hypothesis treats as ordinary vocabulary rather than an unidentified string.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Please write to me at the gmail address that is printed on the back of the conference badge, not the university one, because I check it more often while travelling.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Email topic and the word 'gmail' with no local part and no letter string, the same topic without the claimed feature.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Our lab recently migrated everything to kubernetes and terraform, and the senior engineers say the migration went smoothly with no downtime on the production cluster.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Unfamiliar technical proper nouns but real multi-token words rather than non-lexical strings, so the hypothesis predicts no character-by-character reading and no activation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The committee met on Tuesday and agreed, after a long discussion, that the proposed budget should be revised before the end of the fiscal year and sent back to the finance office for approval.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Plain English control with no identifier at all; guards against attribution to punctuation or sentence-initial words rather than any letter string.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: {"name": "Marta Ruiz", "city": "Lisbon", "role": "analyst", "id": "jdoe"}
adversarial_test_results.detail: Short lowercase handle 'jdoe' with no mixed case, no digits, no punctuation markers and no introducing frame, an unusual position for the feature that the hypothesis says is too short and too word-like to fire.

<!-- build configuration block; do not edit. -->

adversarial_test_results.detail: Delimiter-dense position control: XML tags, dots, digits and a symbol-heavy framework name, but the tokens are structured rather than an unresolved identifier, so the hypothesis predicts no activation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The international business machines corporation announced quarterly results and said the north atlantic space agency contract would be renewed for another five years of joint research.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Familiar acronyms spelled out as ordinary words, same entities, no non-lexical string, which the hypothesis says leaves the pole near zero.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The authors of PMID 30421448 and the reviewers of the manuscript at 10.1002/mrm.27594 all agreed that the revised statistics section should be expanded before the journal could accept the paper for publication.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The citation and DOI fragments that appear in the bibliography top example, embedded in ordinary prose about the paper, with no surrounding citation block and no alphanumeric string being read out.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: On the server I saw two listeners named HTTPProxy and EventsListeners, and I configured the root directory under /var/lib/docker on the staging machine last night without any error messages.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same docker configuration vocabulary as top example 6 but only its dictionary-word tokens and CamelCase names, none of the alphanumeric hash value, a topic-without-feature near miss.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Pangram Pangram is proud to release a new collection of retail marketing posters for the spring season, designed by our in-house team over the winter months.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Repeated nonce token in prose where the same string is both adjacent and familiar from the first mention, testing whether any adjacent non-word pair fires the pole regardless of unfamiliarity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: We received the package in under 48 hours, but the 3 items inside were the wrong size and I am still waiting for a replacement for order 4821.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Ordinary digits in prose at several positions, which the hypothesis says are read as numbers rather than as an alphanumeric identifier and should not activate.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After the merger closed the subsidiary filed a Form 10-K with the Securities and Exchange Commission and disclosed that two directors of the parent company had resigned from the board the previous week.
adversarial_test_results.detail: SEC filing identifier ('10-K') in a legal register the hypothesis does not cover, versus the 'company name (TICKER)' frame it claims; label token present in the wrong context.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Rentz (RRV)
adversarial_test_results.detail: The minimal 'name (TICKER)' label frame with an unseen string, the exact structure the hypothesis singles out, expressed without any of the longer example text.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The trademark was registered by Norkraft (ZQXL) and the filing lists a business address in Portland.
adversarial_test_results.detail: A new named entity with a mixed-letter unknown ticker, same label-introduction construction the hypothesis says is strongest, new proper names only.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Contact address: m.okafor@brynmawr-consulting.co.uk; please copy the document to my colleague before Friday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: An e-mail local part made of initials plus a surname that is not a dictionary word, a paraphrase of claimed activating token 'je' in a new context, inside a labelled contact field rather than a narrative sentence.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: See the upstream report at https://gitlab.example.com/torvalds/linux/-/commit/9f3c2ab7e1d4 and the mirrored discussion at https://stackoverflow.com/questions/4821 for context.
